description: The power harness W002 was reviewed by Designer 1, checked by Checker 1 and released as version 1.0.0 by Releaser 1, with points 1 to 20 of the review checklist ticked and the EXAMPLE values and parts accepted with a reason; then its version 1.1.0 was started, which makes W002-L1 0.1 m longer. Look at log DIR W002, diff DIR W002, the version report and the Review sheet after an export, and the Releases tab; the manual pages Release a harness, Change a released harness and Versions explain it.
name: Released harness (EXAMPLE)
